paper_citation: Carey AA, Tanaka Y, van der Meer MAA (2019). Reward revaluation biases hippocampal replay content away from the preferred outcome. Nature Neuroscience 22, 1450-1459. https://doi.org/10.1038/s41593-019-0464-6
apparatus: elevated T-maze with food at the end of the left arm and water at the end of the right, a pedestal beside each arm for rest between trials and a flower pot for rest before and after

archive.name: DataLad labs/mvdm/MotivationalT

sampling_rate.source: each VT1.nvt header: SamplingFrequency 29.97 (the default session's frames are a median 33.1 ms apart, 30.2 Hz)

position_span.source: keys.m realTrackDims, 185 x 167 cm, or 139 x 185 cm for R042: the largest span of the tracked positions must lie within 20% of 185 cm

speed_limit.source: Iriarte-Díaz 2002, J. Exp. Biol. 205:2897-2908, Table 1: Rattus runs at most 13.78 body lengths/s at a 0.190 m body length, 2.62 m/s (from Garland 1983 and Nowak 1999); times 1.5 because the tracked point is a head-mounted LED pair, which swings faster than the body, and no source read states head speed

sessions.verification: Checked by hand on 2026-11-05 against the files, the archive's README.txt and datapackage.json, the paper and its supplement, its code (vandermeerlab/papers at 3aebc8e, vandermeerlab/vandermeerlab at ad0bbd4, read, not run) and its candidate file for this session. Files: each pinned by the SHA-256 of its git-annex key and fetched against it. Time: 148,871 video frames, 1539.15 to 6522.17 s, a median 33.1 ms apart (30.2 Hz; the header says 29.97), with stops of 7.6 and 8.1 s between the recording blocks; the LFP's 9,935,360 samples are the times of the candidate file's tvec to 1 us. Spikes: 72 units (30 .t, 42 ._t), 422,017 spikes, 1539.19 to 6522.16 s; population firing peaks at the centre of the paper's candidates, which come from the LFP. Events: the 11 food and 9 water dispenses each fall in a left or right trial, one per trial. Space: the drawn trajectories in pixels and cm differ by keys.m's convFact; the path follows the graph in the overview, with the rest pedestals off it; 5,569 frames (3.7%) have no tracked point. Score: the joint score built from this archive's LFP, spikes and 50 hand-labelled SWRs correlates 0.9999997 with the score stored in the paper's candidate file. The overview and three animation frames were looked at.
